title: drift_monitor: code and numerical evidence for audit-limited manufacturing inspection monitoring
description: Simulation library, exact finite-horizon CUSUM computation, detection-limit (Neyman-Pearson) calculations, experiment pipelines (matched comparison, robustness, audit allocation, AOI replays), prespecified protocols, seeds and numerical results for the study 'Manufacturing Inspection Monitoring under Sparse and Delayed Audits: Detection Limits and Audit Planning'. The PCB replay of the study uses proprietary data; its data, code and results are not included.
